history.commit.nameTooLong: A commit name is at most 80 characters
history.commit.noneAfter: There is nothing newer than commit {seq}
history.commit.noneOrCut: There is no commit {seq} (no such number, or before where the history was cut)
history.revert.line: Revert ({count} commits, back to right after commit {seq})
history.revert.locked: main is locked, so it cannot be reverted (revert once a person unlocks it in the app)
history.revert.othersIn: Not reverted, as it includes commits by other writers: {commits}. Other writers' commits can be undone one at a time with undo of branch_revert, with request: true
history.revertIntoBranch.line: main as of right after commit {seq} ({count} commits undone; it goes into main by merge)
history.undo.already: What commit {seq} changed is already as it was before it
history.undo.holderGone: {path} cannot come back, as {holder} it was in is gone
history.undo.lineAsked: Undo what commit {seq} ({who}) changed (allowed on the screen)
history.undo.others: Commit {seq} is another writer's ({who}), so it is not undone (MCP undoes it only through the item branch_revert.others)
history.undo.taken: {path} cannot come back, as something else is there now (rename or delete one of them first)
history.undo.wroteNothing: Commit {seq} changed no document, so there is nothing to undo
history.undoIntoBranch.line: main with what commit {seq} ({who}) changed undone (it goes into main by merge)
history.undoIntoBranch.lineAsked: main with what commit {seq} ({who}) changed undone (allowed on the screen; it goes into main by merge)
